Founded in 1994 by Jeff Bezos and headquartered in Seattle, Washington, Amazon.com, Inc. is a global technology and retail
leader. Driven by its core mission to be "Earth's most customer-centric company," Amazon has transformed from an online bookstore into one of the
world's largest e-commerce marketplaces and cloud computing infrastructure platforms.
Operates vast online storefronts and physical retail locations, offering millions of products directly and through third-party
Provides scalable cloud computing, storage, database management, and artificial intelligence solutions to
Delivers digital entertainment through Prime Video, Amazon Music, and Kindle e-books, anchored by the Amazon
Offers performance-based digital advertising tools for sellers, vendors, and brand partners across its ecosystem.

AWS is investing $5.3 billion to launch its first
cloud region in Saudi Arabia by December 2026. The region includes 50 megawatts of dedicated AI
capacity and aims to upskill 100,000 citizens in cloud technologies.
In August 2026, AWS announced an agreement to acquire
DuckLabs (the team behind DuckDB) to strengthen its cloud analytics infrastructure and high-
performance database tools for enterprise customers.
In its Q2 2026 financial results, Amazon reported $200.6 billion
in quarterly net sales (up 20% YoY), driven by an accelerating AWS cloud segment that jumped
37% YoY to reach a $169 billion annualized run rate.
